question: Determine the correctly matched pair for Gupta-era obligations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dasaparadha - fines from ten offences**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Dasaparadha** refers to fines imposed for ten specific offences during the Gupta era, highlighting the structured legal system of that period.
 
• The term is derived from "Dasa" (ten) and "Aparadha" (offences), showcasing the categorization of crimes and penalties.
